03 / About George

Curious by nature.
Organised by practice.

I’m George Okochar, a product designer based in Nigeria. My background brings together Computer Science, interface design, practical testing, and client coordination.

I’ve worked on products across mobility, invoicing, business documents, real estate, e-commerce, and SaaS. The work has taken me from mapping onboarding journeys and multi-step forms to reviewing deployed interfaces and preparing developer handovers.

At Vetra Studio, I work with startups and small businesses from the initial brief through feedback and delivery. At Entryza, I contribute responsive interfaces and reusable components for a ticketing and mobility platform serving Nigeria and Cameroon.

I’m also co-founding CampusCrib, a student housing marketplace in development. My contributions span the product concept, interface system, front-end architecture, and business materials.

My freelance virtual-assistant experience included calendars, meetings, travel, correspondence, and task tracking. Those skills carry into how I manage client feedback and project handovers.
